conditions.scope: Actual serial operations; callbacks from registered listeners after startup only. Restart endpoints captured; no bootstrap callback trace claim.
conditions.failure_source: Exact existing yaml_worker_failure.json object-cycle case0; no unknown crash probe.
conditions.callback_snapshots: JSON tree clones at callback time; path graph membership distinguishes absent from empty objects.
conditions.readiness: Initialized + isCacheClean + actual rounded disk/live/filecache stats+SHA256 + two stable turns; failed worker cache null permitted; committed readonly IDB transaction.done separate. External active work additionally requires observed changed callback carrying current source text.

limitations: Event order is actual observed order in this serial scenario; concurrency/batch ordering and arbitrary handler reentrancy are not universal claims.
Restart listeners registered after initialization; restart endpoints are certified, startup callback history is not captured.
Callback cache arguments/snapshots are JSON tree clones; typed constructors/identity are separately covered by cache_typed.json.
Outside-vault nI hasUsers/stat guards are source-backed; active work readiness specifically requires changed callback with current external source rather than ordinary isCacheClean alone.

Native event/state performance timestamps are facts, not portable exact scheduling equality. Callback file_info vs actual TFile file_stat and info_stat_matches preserve stale/current relation without cross-runtime timestamp equality.
Initial same-matrix capture lacking callback file_stat is retained native-basic.json; instrumented capture is authority and adds no scenario branch.
